mongodb.subDescription: Master the modern storage unit for the AI era. From flexible document storage to Atlas Vector Search and Agentic memory.

phases.title: Touring the Facility: Databases & Collections
theory: MongoDB vs SQL: Flexible Bins vs Fixed Cabinets
The Storage Building (Database) and Storage Units (Collections)
Flexible Folders (Documents): Why unstructured data is great for AI JSON outputs
Digital Tags (ObjectIds): The auto-generated tracking number
BSON: The language the storage robot speaks
practicals: Add a flexible document generated by an LLM to a collection

phases.title: Adding & Finding Folders: CRUD Basics
theory: insertOne & insertMany: Dropping off new shipments
The Search Robot (find): Looking for specific items
Projection: Asking the robot to only show certain items inside the folder
Sorting & Pagination: Arranging folders by date or skipping to the next aisle
practicals: Store 5 unique chat-history folders in the 'Conversations' unit

phases.title: Search Power-ups: Advanced Operators
theory: Comparison Operators ($gt, $lt): The 'Range Finder' tools
Logical Operators ($and, $or): Combining search rules
Array Operators ($in, $push): Handling folders that contain lists
Regex: Searching for folders using partial text
Text Search: Setting up Lucene-powered full-text search indexing
practicals: Update a chat folder to add a new 'message' using $push
Perform a full-text search on product descriptions

phases.title: The Barcode System: Indexing
theory: What is Indexing? The back-of-book index for your storage unit
Single vs Compound Indexes: Indexing by one label vs multiple
The Trade-off: Faster searching vs slower storage speed
Explain Mode: Checking if the robot is scanning every folder or using the index
practicals: Create a barcode (Index) for 'Email' to speed up staff login
Use 'Explain' to prove the robot is working faster with the barcode

phases.title: The Conveyor Belt: Aggregation Framework
theory: Aggregation Pipeline: A series of stations on a conveyor belt
$match & $sort: The first stations (Filter & Order)
$group & $sum: The calculation stations (Counting totals)
$lookup: Grabbing a matching folder from a different bin as it passes by
practicals: Build a pipeline to calculate total token usage 'By User'
Use $lookup to bring 'User Profiles' into the 'Chat Logs' belt

phases.title: AI Vector Search: The Brain's Memory
theory: Vector Databases vs Standard DBs: Searching by 'meaning' not exact match
Storing Embeddings in MongoDB: Arrays of floats (e.g., [0.12, -0.44, ...])
Atlas Vector Search: Setting up vector indexes
Cosine Similarity & $vectorSearch: Finding mathematically related documents
RAG with MongoDB: Powering your LLM with database context
practicals: Store an OpenAI embedding inside a MongoDB document
Run an Atlas $vectorSearch to find the top 3 most relevant documents to a user's prompt
Build a 'Semantic Product Search' that finds products similar to a description

phases.title: Global Scaling & Advanced Operations
theory: Replication: Keeping copies of your storage facility for safety
Sharding: Breaking a massive facility into multiple smaller ones (Shard keys for Vector search)
Transactions: The 'All-or-Nothing' storage contract (ACID)
Change Streams: Listening to real-time warehouse inventory updates
Capped Collections: Fixed-size circular storage for high-speed AI logging buffers
practicals: Mock a 'Money Transfer' using Multi-document Transactions
Set up a Change Stream listener to feed database writes directly to an AI monitoring agent

mongodb-questions.subDescription: 50+ common questions. Master NoSQL and Vector Search concepts for interviews.

phases.title: Ground Level: Core Concepts
theory: MongoDB vs SQL (Flexible Bins vs Rigid Cabinets)
When to Embed vs Reference (The Receipt Analogy)
What is BSON? (The Robot's internal language)
practicals: Explain Aggregation using the 'Conveyor Belt' metaphor

phases.title: Top Floor: AI & Performance
theory: How does Atlas Vector Search compare to a dedicated vector DB like Pinecone?
Explain how to construct a $vectorSearch aggregation pipeline.
Sharding Strategies for massive AI datasets
Covered Queries (When the robot doesn't even open the folder)
practicals: Design an index strategy for a 'High Traffic' storage unit with vector embeddings
